about: Titles written by hand where the generated name files have none or a wrong one. They take precedence over data/names/*.json when the data is bundled. Spanish follows the style of data/names/es.json (San, Santa and Santos in full; the category in lower case). The Spanish is to be read through by a reviewer who knows the 1962 calendar.

feria.why: Divinum Officium has no file for a plain feria.

for-octave-of-the-nativity.why: Missale Meum's commemoration of the octave (12-26c); no Divinum Officium file. Worded like Divinum Officium's own 'De la Maternidad…'.

nat1-1.es: Día dentro de la Octava de Navidad
nat1-1.why: No Divinum Officium file; the Spanish ordos name these days 'Octava de Navidad'.

immaculate-heart-of-mary.es: Inmaculado Corazón de la Bienaventurada Virgen María
immaculate-heart-of-mary.why: The Spanish file's title is in English.

most-holy-name-of-mary.why: Divinum Officium gives it only under [Rank] ('Smo. Nombre de María').

nativity-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.es: Natividad de la Santísima Virgen María
nativity-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.why: Divinum Officium gives it only under [Rank].

our-lady-of-ransom.why: Divinum Officium gives it only under [Rank].

seven-sorrows-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.es: Siete Dolores de la Santísima Virgen María
seven-sorrows-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.why: Divinum Officium gives it only under [Rank] ('Los Siete Dolores de la Sma. Virgen María').

seven-sorrows-in-passiontide.es: Conmemoración de los Siete Dolores de la Santísima Virgen María
seven-sorrows-in-passiontide.why: Missale Meum's commemoration on the Friday of Passion Week; no Divinum Officium file.

our-lady-on-saturday-advent.es: Santa María en sábado – Misa I, Rorate
our-lady-on-saturday-advent.why: Missale Meum's Masses of Our Lady on Saturday come from the Commune, which has no Spanish title. 'Santa María en sábado' is the Spanish ordos' name.

our-lady-on-saturday-christmastide.es: Santa María en sábado – Misa II, Vultum tuum

our-lady-on-saturday-after-purification.es: Santa María en sábado – Misa III, Salve, sancta Parens

our-lady-on-saturday-paschaltide.es: Santa María en sábado – Misa IV, Salve, sancta Parens

our-lady-on-saturday-after-pentecost.es: Santa María en sábado – Misa V, Salve, sancta Parens

st-barbara.why: Added to the catalogue by hand (data/reviewed/additions.json), so no Divinum Officium file is read.

st-basilides.es: Santos Basílides, Cirino, Nabor y Nazario, mártires
st-basilides.why: The Spanish file's title is in Latin.

st-peter-damian.es: San Pedro Damián, obispo, confesor y doctor de la Iglesia
st-peter-damian.why: The Spanish file's title is in Latin.

st-thomas-becket.es: Santo Tomás Becket, obispo y mártir
st-thomas-becket.why: The Spanish file's title is in Latin.

sts-marcellinus-peter-and-erasmus.es: Santos Marcelino, Pedro y Erasmo, mártires
sts-marcellinus-peter-and-erasmus.why: The Spanish file's title is in Latin.

st-paul.why: The commemoration of St. Paul on the Chair of St. Peter (Missale Meum 02-22c); no Divinum Officium file.

st-peter.why: The commemoration of St. Peter on the Conversion of St. Paul (Missale Meum 01-25c); no Divinum Officium file.

st-petronilla.why: Missale Meum's commemoration (05-31c); no Divinum Officium file.

sts-cyriacus-largus-and-smaragdus-martyr.es: Santos Ciriaco, Largo y Esmaragdo, mártires
sts-cyriacus-largus-and-smaragdus-martyr.why: Missale Meum's commemoration (08-08c); no Divinum Officium file. Spelled as Divinum Officium's own feast of 8 August.

sts-sergius-bacchus-marcellus-and-apulei.es: Santos Sergio, Baco, Marcelo y Apuleyo, mártires
sts-sergius-bacchus-marcellus-and-apulei.why: Missale Meum's commemoration (10-08c); no Divinum Officium file.

sts-symphorosa-and-sons.es: Santa Sinforosa y sus siete hijos, mártires
sts-symphorosa-and-sons.why: Missale Meum's commemoration (07-18cc); no Divinum Officium file.

st-john-mary-vianney.why: Missale Meum's id (sancti:08-08) names the file Divinum Officium uses for Sts. Cyriacus, Largus and Smaragdus.

st-telesphorus-pope-and-martyr.why: Missale Meum's id (sancti:01-05) names Divinum Officium's file for the Vigil of the Epiphany, abolished in 1955.

octave-day-of-christmas.es: Octava de la Natividad del Señor
octave-day-of-christmas.why: Divinum Officium's Spanish keeps the name before 1960, 'Circuncisión del Señor'; the 1960 calendar names the day 'In Octava Nativitatis Domini', and both Toledo ordos print 'Octava de la Natividad de Nuestro Señor'.

our-lady-of-lourdes.es: Aparición de la Bienaventurada Virgen María Inmaculada
our-lady-of-lourdes.why: The 1962 title is 'In Apparitione Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae'; Divinum Officium's Spanish leaves out Inmaculada.

queenship-of-the-blessed-virgin-mary.why: Reina is the feast's title here, not a saint's category; the importer lowered it.

dedication-of-the-basilica-of-st-mary-ma.es: Dedicación de Santa María de las Nieves
dedication-of-the-basilica-of-st-mary-ma.why: Divinum Officium's Spanish gives only 'Santa María de las Nieves'; the feast is the dedication of the basilica.

sts-felicitas-and-perpetua.why: Two women: Santas, not Santos (Divinum Officium writes 'Ss.').

pope-sixtus-ii-felicissimus-and-agapitus.es: Santos Sixto II, papa, Felicísimo y Agapito, mártires
pope-sixtus-ii-felicissimus-and-agapitus.why: Divinum Officium writes the categories with capitals and without commas ('Sixto II Papa, y Felicísimo y Agapito Mártires').

sts-cornelius-and-cyprian.es: Santos Cornelio, papa, y Cipriano, obispo, mártires
sts-cornelius-and-cyprian.why: Divinum Officium writes 'Cornelio Papa y Cipriano Obispo'.

sts-alexander-and-companions.es: Santos Alejandro I, papa, Evencio y Teódulo, mártires, y Juvenal, obispo y confesor
sts-alexander-and-companions.why: Divinum Officium writes 'Alejandro I Papa' and 'obispo confesor'.
